== Outreach ==

=== OryCon ===

* What kind of session would we like to have?
** Lots of writer-focused sessions happen there
** Lots of space-related things too (naturally)
** Potential topics for us:
*** Religion in science fiction
*** Environmentalism in science fiction
*** Social movements inspired by science fiction (would have to mention Scientology)
*** Seeds of Gaia: Going to space for the sake of Life ... picking this one
*** The Gaia Hypothesis in science and science fiction 
**** 45th anniversary this year ... how has it aged?
** We'd want non-SolSeed people on the panel
*** Windward
*** Gus the Space Hippie
** Who do we want to find?
*** People who want to be part of a movement
*** Intersection of Portland environmental types and OryCon sci-fi types
** What to put in the blurb?
*** Downplay the "real-life community" aspect?
*** Talk about it as a brainstorming session about various ways to promote this ideal?

'''Seeds of Gaia: Going to space for the sake of Life'''

Join us to discuss the flowering of Gaia into places beyond Earth.  In this future, spaceships are little worlds unto themselves, filled with living ecosystems that sustain spacefarers' souls even as they maintain the air, water, and food supply.  The mission of these "seed ships" has more to do with bringing life to other worlds than taking resources out of them to feed human industry.  What are the historical roots of this idea?  Which groups most closely hold this vision today?  What are they up to?  How can you get involved?
